'''Ōtomo Shrine''' (大伴神社) refers to several shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Takaoka)|ja|大伴神社 (高岡市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtomo Shrine (Takaoka)|1=Ōtomo Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11432351}} - Located in Fushiki Ichinomiya, Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Saku, Mochizuki)|ja|大伴神社 (佐久市望月)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtomo Shrine (Saku, Mochizuki)|qq=}} - Located in Mochizuki, Saku City, Nagano Prefecture. Considered a candidate for an {{ill|Ancient shrine|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ancient shrine|13=User:Immanuelle|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|lt=Shikinaisha}}.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Saku, Nozawa)|ja|大伴神社 (佐久市野澤)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtomo Shrine (Saku, Nozawa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Nozawa, Saku City, Nagano Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtomo Shrine (Ōtsu)|ja|大伴神社 (大津市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtomo Shrine (Ōtsu)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Minamishiga, Ōtsu City, Shiga Prefecture. Also known as Ōtomo Kurohito Shrine or Ōtomo Kurohito Shrine.
* {{ill|Sumiyoshi Ōtomo Shrine|ja|住吉大伴神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sumiyoshi Ōtomo Shrine|qq=}} - Located in Ryōanji Sumiyoshichō, Ukyo-ku, Kyoto City, Kyoto Prefecture. Considered a candidate for an ancient shrine.
